items.title: Gate-push fix (4f77e2f)
items.state: complete on its own code line, not used by the LangGraph runtime
items.detail: Branch live/gate-push-binding (4f77e2f, built on the ledger commit 61ca8c9) makes git_push publish only the commit the gate approved, then checks every push destination. The final independent review accepted it with no defect for the race and verifier fix. This was an offline review of a public branch: it is not a rollout, a live run or a security certification. Source check: the execution code line (d4a7485) shares only an old common ancestor with this line and does not contain or call this executor, so there is nothing to integrate and no integration progress is claimed. Known limits: the branch tip is read once and not atomically, a single writer is assumed, and file-system and symlink trust are unchanged.
items.unlocks: Any use of this executor is a separate, later decision.
items.done_when: Complete as a fix on its own line. Wiring it anywhere would need its own reviewed change.

items.title: Remaining WP4 and WP9 work
items.state: flow mechanics shown; WP9 comparison code published offline; real WP4 re-proof model-blocked
items.detail: Completed context: the LangGraph coordination bus treated an errored push as not landed when it could not read the remote, then reset its commit and retried; the fix (keeps the commit, stops on an unreadable remote, retries only on a provable absence, checks every destination) was reviewed offline on its exact commits and the execution line moved d4a7485 to 5e140fc on Nov 5, a fast-forward with nothing else changed. The bus is not exactly-once; absence is proven only at read time. Then the Reviewer-skip acceptance guard WP4 and WP10 needed: accepted after three offline review rounds and published on the execution line (live/operator-done 5e140fc fast-forwarded to a1c36ce, reviewed code only, no activation). A DONE claim now closes only with a fresh QC PASS verdict: whole-line bare 'PASS'/'QC PASS', optionally 'at head <sha>' bound to the real head, newest QC verdict wins, the DONE turn's own application writes refuse the close, and a QC turn may self-close on its own earlier PASS only with the bare word DONE. Evidence scope: 44 focused checks and the 32-file offline suite pass author-run in one sandbox; the independent reviewer probed each round and accepted this pin scoped to the guard (no suite run by reviewers); the endurance example was not rerun on the final pin. Limits carried: verdict rows are cooperative .team records (roster role claim, not identity); freshness is the ancestor-plus-evidence-paths narrowing of the spec; no-QC parking restores a turn by hand. This is not a WP10 completion and not an autonomy claim. Done since: a scripted-seat demonstration of the WP4 acceptance flow on this pin (live/wp4-reproof 4b2c5ba, not integrated) - unattended guarded close, same application bytes at verdict and close; independent review confirmed the mechanics but ruled it is no WP4 re-proof (predetermined seats, no negative path). Remaining here: WP4's real qualification, which needs model-backed Reviewer and QC judgment and stays blocked on a model route (own grounding and authority required), and WP9's matched savings comparison, still blocked on provider composition; WP9's request-ID join already exists (launcher/usage_join.py). Update: the WP9 matched comparison now exists as offline code on live/wp9-matched-compare (08732d0, reviewed; not wired into a runner, caller-supplied inputs unauthenticated, no actual matched provider data and no measured saving, so WP9 is not complete). A model-backed WP4 team attempt hit a launch fault: no deliverable, one Builder request with unknown outcome and cost, no WP4 credit; model runs are on hold.
items.after: A grounded, authorized, safe execution route for model-backed runs; two arms of matched provider-reported usage for WP9.
items.unlocks: WP4 progress credit once its re-proof evidence is independently reviewed; WP10 stays open.
items.done_when: WP4 re-proof evidence accepted by an independent review; WP9 comparison unblocked.
